cases.tolerance_rationale: Initial one-microhartree-per-conventional-cell comparison target; convergence ladders and matched inputs are required before scientific acceptance.
cases.notes: Restricted starter control, not the full production matrix. Qualify the actual CRYSTAL executable/version and basis/functional conventions before interpreting a passing energy comparison. BIPOLE refuses lih_rocksalt's default 12-bohr lattice cutoff (S(Gamma) fold drift 2.5e-1 from the STO-3G Li 2sp tail); measured drift 7.0e-2 at 16, 3.3e-3 at 20, 5.3e-4 at 24 and 1.1e-5 at 28 bohr, so these rows declare 28. One Gamma RHF took 47 min locally (2026-10-23).
